{{Top|leg}}
During the [[Battle of Ithor]] [[Anakin Solo]] and [[Daeshara'cor]] were designated as '''Team Twelve'''. Their mission was to defend the [[Ithorian Herdship]] ''[[Tafanda Bay]]'' against the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. Solo was floored by a [[Chazrach|reptoid]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] punching a [[Limb/Legends|leg]] wound and came under attack from a Yuuzhan Vong [[Warrior caste|warrior]]. Daeshara'cor was able to save him, but not before being [[Death/Legends|fatally]] wounded by an [[amphistaff]] bite.
